0.why: SRC.cpp:164 setVoltage(on ? voltage : 0.0f), voltage clamped to ±11

comment: In Hold mode the ON input is cast straight to a bool (SRC.cpp:97), so any voltage that is not exactly zero counts as raised, negative ones included, and the result is exclusive-or'd with the button rather than replacing it. The maker's tooltip for the button is On/Off; the panel prints ON above the jack beside it, so the two carry the same word.
